name: Crew-13
slot_a_text: SpaceX Crew-13 is the thirteenth crewed operational flight of a Crew Dragon spacecraft to the International Space Station as part of NASA's Commercial Crew Program.
slot_b_text: SLC-40 has flown 401 launches since it opened, 48 of them this year. The pad had 17 days to reset after the last one.

program_description: The Commercial Crew Program (CCP) is a human spaceflight program operated by NASA, in association with American aerospace manufacturers Boeing and SpaceX.
